calls.statement:
SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period_label,
  SUM(f.net_amount - COALESCE(r.refund_net, 0)) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.sales_line_id = f.sales_line_id
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 52
  AND p.category = 'Garden'
  AND p.product_key != 999  -- filter store 999
  AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'  -- filter test category
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period_label, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

-- Build net sales with returns properly accounted for
WITH net_lines AS (
  SELECT 
    f.sales_line_id,
    f.sale_date,
    d.fiscal_period,
    d.fiscal_period_label,
    p.category,
    s.store_id,
    f.net_amount AS sales_net,
    COALESCE(r.refund_net, 0) AS return_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.sales_line_id = f.sales_line_id
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 52
    AND p.category = 'Garden'
    AND s.store_id < 900  -- filter store 999
    AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'  -- filter test category
)
SELECT 
  fiscal_period_label,
  fiscal_period,
  ROUND(SUM(sales_net - return_net), 2) AS net_sales
FROM net_lines
GROUP BY fiscal_period_label, fiscal_period
ORDER BY fiscal_period

-- Following the net_sales_pattern from the library
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    -- sales: stores on the sale date, web on the Helsinki dispatch date
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date,
           d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_period_label,
           p.category,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date)
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 52
      AND p.category = 'Garden'
    UNION ALL
    -- returns reduce net sales on the return date
    SELECT r.return_date,
           d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_period_label,
           p.category,
           -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 52
      AND p.category = 'Garden'
)
SELECT 
  fiscal_period_label,
  fiscal_period,
  ROUND(SUM(net_sales), 2) AS net_sales
FROM net_lines
GROUP BY fiscal_period_label, fiscal_period
ORDER BY fiscal_period

    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    -- sales: stores on the sale date, web on the Helsinki dispatch date
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date,
           p.category,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND p.category = 'Garden'
    UNION ALL
    -- returns reduce net sales on the return date
    SELECT r.return_date,
           p.category,
           -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND p.category = 'Garden'
),
with_period AS (
    SELECT n.business_date,
           d.fiscal_period, 
           d.fiscal_period_label,
           n.net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 52
)
SELECT 
  fiscal_period_label,
  fiscal_period,
  ROUND(SUM(net_sales), 2) AS net_sales
FROM with_period
GROUP BY fiscal_period_label, fiscal_period
ORDER BY fiscal_period
